reply_text:
I replied to Ottilie in a thread on her #canyon-team message. I confirmed I've noted 337 seats for the Vellmoor Bonded Storage 2027 renewal. The brain had already saved her message.

I also pointed out one mismatch in that reply. On Sep 28 she said in the same channel that Vellmoor's current order form covers 419 seats of Pemberline Dock. So 337 would mean 82 fewer seats at renewal, if that's what she intended.

A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it didn't need approval. As she asked, I took no other action.
